resources.string: Your Mac is looking for this phone
Screen is being mirrored to your Mac
Link to Mac only gets the access you allow here. Everything stays in your local Wi-Fi – nothing is sent to the internet.
Needed for the connection status, received files and \"find my phone\".
Lets the app read your notifications so they appear on the Mac, and lets you reply or dismiss them there. Also needed for media control.
Read your conversations, show new messages on the Mac and send SMS from the Mac.
Show incoming calls on the Mac, answer or decline them, dial numbers and show your call history. You still talk on the phone itself.
Shows names instead of phone numbers for messages and calls.
Shows your latest photos and screenshots in the Mac gallery.
Only for screen mirroring: lets you tap, swipe and type on the phone with the Mac\'s mouse and keyboard. Enable \"Link to Mac control\" in the list.
Prevents Android from stopping the connection in the background.
Notification access or accessibility greyed out?
Android blocks these settings for apps that were installed as an APK. Open the app info, tap the menu (⋮) at the top right and choose \"Allow restricted settings\". Then try again.
Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: add Link to Mac to \"Never sleeping apps\". In the app info set battery to \"Unrestricted\".
Open Link to Mac on your Mac, choose Settings → Pair phone and scan the QR code.
This is not a Link to Mac QR code.
Pairing was declined on the Mac.
Pairing failed: %1$s. Phone and Mac must be in the same Wi-Fi.
The camera is needed to scan the QR code.
Click \"Allow\" on your Mac to finish pairing.
Saved in Downloads/LinkToMac – tap to open
The connection to %1$s will be removed. You can pair again at any time.
See notifications, SMS, calls and photos on your Mac, exchange files and the clipboard, and mirror your screen – directly through your Wi-Fi.
1. Install Link to Mac on your Mac\n2. Open Settings → Pair phone there\n3. Scan the QR code with this phone
Lets your Mac control this phone with mouse and keyboard while the screen is mirrored. Only active while you use the mirror window.
